kind: Existing WebGL2 texture immutable-allocation and sampler-state audit
limits: Never uploads, regenerates mips, changes texture settings or calls renderer.resetState.
IMMUTABLE_LEVELS describes allocated levels, not their content freshness or filtering correctness.
Mutable allocations and not-uploaded objects are unknown unless the optional colour-attachment definition probe supplies additional evidence.
Depth, solver/numeric state, metadata and lookup roles require semantic filtering; they are not ordinary colour mip requirements.
No gl.getError drain: pre-existing application error state is not consumed by the audit.
Optional mutable probe only attaches existing images to an owned READ framebuffer and checks completeness; it never reads or writes texture pixels.
Colour-attachment completeness proves an image is defined/renderable, not its exact dimensions, sampling-chain consistency, current contents or filtering quality.
Cube faces and layered levels are all covered only when the bounded per-texture attachment budget completes; partial results remain unknown.
